support.original_edges: Existing prepared directed int64 COO; unique pairs required; original loops preserved
support.candidate: Incoming raw-X cosine top20 over all other canonical nodes; label-blind stable source-ID tie handling
support.zero_feature_rows: Cosine zeros and same deterministic source-ID ties
support.union: Observed support plus candidate edges; sorted destination then source; deduplicated
support.new_edge_barrier: At least one candidate directed pair must be absent from original support or preparation fails
support.transductive: Only the same complete allowed X used by native graph models; no new observations or labels
support.saved_custody: FEATURE_SUPPORT.npz contains exact original/union COO; FEATURE_SUPPORT.json records hashes/counts/provider/preparation costs

learned_kernel.projection: One bias-free300x16 trainable Parameter per fitted body/bank, shared within a bank
learned_kernel.projection_initializer: Local CPU generator at native body seed+5000011; uniform +/-1/sqrt(300); no global RNG draw
learned_kernel.metric: softplus(raw)+1e-4, initial value1; private M4 has4x16 raw Parameters, common/M1 has1x16
learned_kernel.query_key: normalize((X@Phi)*metric, eps1e-12); raw X only; no learned native H or class-label input
learned_kernel.normalization: Differentiable supported incoming-row softmax; detached max shift only; no clamped scores or repair
learned_kernel.reuse: One kernel computation per complete factual forward; reused across both native SAGE layers; no cache across updates/VALID/restoration
learned_kernel.fixed_control: Uniform incoming weights on the identical union; zero kernel parameters
learned_kernel.attention_collision: Restricted multihead dot-product graph attention with tied Q/K and shared slow value/message maps; private diagonal score form and route identities are not novelty

weighted_native_SAGE.necessary_change: Per-instance original SAGEConv.forward uses explicit differentiable weighted incoming sum before original lin_l and root lin_r
weighted_native_SAGE.continued_computation: Original concatenation [H,message], feed-forward/GELU/dropout, normalization/residual and second weighted SAGE layer; original output head
weighted_native_SAGE.supported: Homogeneous float32 full-node COO, original PyG SAGEConv mean/source_to_target/root enabled, project=false/normalize=false/node_dim=-2/decomposed_layers=1/explain off
weighted_native_SAGE.source_custody: Actual native PyG class source file bytes/hash recorded before override; root still validates dependency version/hash
weighted_native_SAGE.original_Parameter_identity: lin_l/lin_r and native body parameters are retained; helper registered once after original factor wrapping, before .to and optimizer

native_recipe.native_constructor_factor_starts: Original parent factory before helper installation; private input Rademacher seeds preserved
native_recipe.native_dropout_streams: Original per-member CPU/CUDA fork/resume; kernel preparation/init/scoring consume no native/global random draws
native_recipe.own_objective: Mean own CE across current routes and all580 TRAIN nodes; each separately fitted I4 body has unscaled own CE
native_recipe.gradient_recipients: Ordinary scalar derivative through every live native shared/private and registered kernel parameter; no protected/selective/routing rule
native_recipe.steps: One native factual forward per route, one scalar backward and AdamW step per optimizer update
native_recipe.selector: Original first strict full5274 VALID native probability-mean accuracy maximum; exact ties retain earlier state regardless of NLL
native_recipe.restore: All native/kernel Parameters plus optimizer and persistent member streams; fresh kernel recomputed
native_recipe.genuine_I4: Four bodies, kernels, optimizers, stream sets, own selectors and restorations fitted separately; probabilities combined only afterward
native_recipe.serving: Native float32 member probability mean on the learned/fixed feature support; no graph sampler/label decoder/extra serving head
native_recipe.NLL: Existing float64 log_softmax/logsumexp from archived float32 logits

historical_reference_barrier.root_matches: Original X/E0/ordered roles/source/native constructor/factor starts/config/streams/update/selector/restoration/cost/selected custody before opening

cost_and_trace.support_preparation: Actual inclusive time/peaks, stable-sort entries, raw cosine MACs, exact support hashes/archive bytes
cost_and_trace.kernel_work: Actual projection, metric/normalized coordinates, cosine pairs/MACs, row-softmax or fixed-uniform entries, weighted mean calls/edge visits/message coordinates; includes TRAIN/selection/selected readout
cost_and_trace.native_work: Original actual update/backward/Adam/native TRAIN/VALID/selected graph-call counters
cost_and_trace.restoration: Explicit timed field added; process-lifetime RSS and nested selected-forward/pool subtotals preserved
cost_and_trace.trace: Own CE, kernel mode, complete member/pool native metrics, strict selector/stale state; no hidden auxiliary term

composition_status: Retained building block; any kernel x successful-learning combination requires complete pilot, separately frozen baseline/A/B/A+B and stronger equally equipped references; no ingredient chosen from partial outcomes
publication_claim_status: No novelty/success/competence/graph-specific causal or A* acceptance claim. Known ingredients do not disqualify a useful new combined architecture/analysis, but controls and unused confirmation remain necessary.
